title: Can Blindfolded LLMs Still Trade? An Anonymization-First Framework for Portfolio Optimization
central_strategy: Daily point-in-time S&P 500 data and up to five lagged anonymized headlines feed four Gemini 2.5 Flash agents. Selected structured scores plus 384-dimensional embeddings of Momentum/Risk reasoning form a dynamic sector-and-semantic graph for a trained two-layer GATv2. A trained PPO-DSR policy selects intent and an equity-only Dirichlet Top-20 portfolio with execution inertia and 10 bp turnover cost.

current_release_check.search_observation: The only exact-term code results were paper digests/indexes; no author-attributable source, feature dataset, checkpoint, predictions, or holdings were found.
current_release_check.paper_release_statement: The LLM input/output datasets are planned for release upon publication, not currently exposed.

required_but_missing: Point-in-time anonymized U.S. headlines, sentiment inputs, batch assignments, and proper-noun replacement outputs.
Immutable Gemini request settings and the 1,403-day four-agent output/reasoning dataset.
The GATv2 implementation, all loss weights/targets, trained weights, semantic graph edges, and predictions.
The PPO-DSR implementation, trained seed checkpoints, exact state/action construction, and Optuna search history.
Daily holdings, intent paths, turnover, returns, and seed-level output arrays.
monthly_jkp_assessment.scale_if_regenerated: A monthly top-1,000 port would still require roughly 1.22 million agent-stock evaluations before graph/RL training; batching does not supply the missing historical news or released outputs.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_raw_top20_is_not_blindtrade: RAW Top-20 is an explicit active benchmark. It omits anonymized LLM reasoning, semantic graph learning, intent, Dirichlet allocation, PPO-DSR, and execution inertia, so promoting it would replace the central method.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_is_insufficient: JKP supplies monthly numeric characteristics and returns but not the paper's point-in-time headlines, LLM features, reasoning embeddings, sector/semantic graph, or learned GNN/RL policies.
monthly_jkp_assessment.holdout_leakage_note: The paper screens LLM features for informativeness on the reported holdout; score shuffling tests score structure but cannot validate anonymization or exclude other leakage paths.

closure_rule: Do not relabel Momentum, RAW Top-20, MCap Top-20, shuffled scores, or a new technical proxy as BlindTrade. Reopen only for attributable feature outputs plus trained GNN/RL policy artifacts or an executable causal release.
